<thought>We need a one‑step retrosynthesis where both precursors are commercially available. A feasible disconnection is a Baeyer‑Villiger oxidation of the bicyclic ketone “C1CC=CC2C(=O)C12” with a peracid (e.g., peracetic acid, CH₃CO₃H). The peracid is inexpensive and readily purchasable, and the bicyclic ketone is a simple, commercially available compound. This single oxidation converts the ketone into the methyl β‑keto‑ester of the target. I will verify that both the ketone and peracetic acid are buyable.</thought>
